programme.title: Turtle Paradise 1
programme.desc: Leave your worries from the world above behind and dive into a vibrant undersea world inhabited by the iconic sea turtles, for 2 full hours of Nature Relaxation. Captured by filmmaker collaborators Tilo & Yvonne Kühnast, Turtle Paradise features hundreds of unique real-time video scenes captured from around the Caribbean, paired with gentle underwater sounds & calming music for deep relaxation by Jason Stephenson.

programme.title: Garden of Eden
programme.desc: Discover the world’s natural beauty with beautiful flowers, delicate butterflies, and majestic waterfalls.

programme.title: Peaceful Forest Walk: Quebec
programme.desc: A unique spot in the heart of the Laurentians: gaze over the peaceful lake as its smooth waves gently crawl to the shore.

programme.title: Tropical Beach: Dominican Republic
programme.desc: Wake up to a view of Playa Madama, an unspoilt beach framed by high bluffs at the edge of the Dominican Republic.

programme.title: Camping by the lake
programme.desc: Enjoy some alone time in nature camping out with a relaxing fire next to a quiet lake.

programme.title: Glistening Island Beach
programme.desc: An instant classic and perfect scene for mental escape, "Glistening Island Beach" places viewers underneath a big beautiful palm tree facing a perfect white sandy beach, glistening blue sea, sunshine, and the small boat you arrived in. Filmed in 4K Ultra High Definition on the hidden [and now privately owned] exotic island of Nanuku, where a small atoll is surrounded by an untouched perfect lagoon, miles away from it all....

programme.title: Whiritoa Beach
programme.desc: Discover the raw beauty of this secluded New Zealand beach, surrounded by wildflowers.

programme.title: Turquoise Waters: Mexico
programme.desc: Feel the warm breeze in your hair as you take in the strikingly turquoise waters of Mexico’s Isla Mujeres.

programme.title: Flying Over Norway
programme.desc: Travel north to fly over Norway’s magical fjords, tiny fishing villages, and stunning mountain landscapes.

programme.title: Hidden Tropical Paradise 1
programme.desc: Have you ever wanted to just escape from it all? Now you can turn any screen into a window to a hidden garden island, located in the the remote north-eastern islands of Fiji. Begin your journey as the sun pierces through trees as vibrant blue waves break on a white sandy beach; progress up the island to a lush lookout, and enjoy distant wave breaks, trees and birds, and passing clouds. Finally transport yourself back to the beach as the day continues and end it with a beautiful sunset scene as it falls over a distant mountain. It's 120 minutes of pure nature bliss!

programme.title: A Day in Santorini
programme.desc: Turn any screen into a window the the Greek Islands with this immensely relaxing HD visual journey through the unique and beautiful coastal village of Oia, found on the far tip of Santorini Island. Slowly awaken your senses as the morning sun rises over the sea, and watch as day slowly passes into dusk. Distant waves break and birds chirp adding an a nice ambient music that combines to create a video that's so relaxing it's almost trance-inducing.

programme.title: Humpback Whales
programme.desc: Observe the humble humpback in all its glory. Few things are more majestic than a whale in its natural habitat: a gentle giant that inhabits every one of the world's oceans.

programme.title: Gatra Beach: Indonesia
programme.desc: Skip the forest trek to the beach, but miss none of the sights as you feast your eyes on this slice of paradise. Gatra Beach conservation has everything to satiate your appetite for the more remote destinations in nature.

programme.title: Healing Hawaii: Kauai
programme.desc: Prepare your senses for the ultimate visual & audio journey around the exotic island paradise of Kauai, known as the Garden Isle. Immerse yourself in 60 different one-minute scenes of pure nature bliss, slowly transitioning from one to the next.

programme.title: Flying Over South Korea
programme.desc: Experience the brilliance of South Korea's natural wonders & amazing cityscapes with "Flying Over South Korea", an epic 60 minute ambient aerial film. During the film, viewers will serenely adventure to four of the most famous destinations in South Korea: Jeju Island, Seoul City, Geoje National Park, and Busan.

programme.title: Manuel Antonio Park: Costa Rica
programme.desc: Enjoy the spectacular view of the water framed by lush vegetation in the Manuel Antonio National Park.

programme.title: Soothing Stream: Quebec
programme.desc: This morning, autumn shines its magical, golden light on the rushing waters of the Parc national de la Jacques-Cartier.

programme.title: Date With Nature - Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Feast your eyes on the diverse beauty of Sri Lanka, where lush rainforests, quiet beaches, and vibrant foliage put you in a dreamy trance of natural wonder.

programme.title: Beach Paradise: East Bali
programme.desc: Relax to a serene soundtrack as you journey to spectacular beaches from Bali.

programme.title: Peaceful Farms: New Zealand
programme.desc: Enjoy calming music as you watch animals quietly graze the lush landscape.

programme.title: Gatra Beach: Indonesia
programme.desc: Skip the forest trek to the beach, but miss none of the sights as you feast your eyes on this slice of paradise. Gatra Beach conservation has everything to satiate your appetite for the more remote destinations in nature.

programme.title: A Day on the Napali Coast 3
programme.desc: A 5 hour long ambient nature film featuring the spectacular sights and sounds of the legendary 11-mile long Kalalau Trail. Featuring hundreds of breathtaking yet tranquil scenes with stereo audio, this video begins on Kalalau Beach at sunrise and progresses along the trail over the course of nearly a full day. Viewers will enjoy a countless array of views that overlook the vast blue ocean, where an abundance of wildlife and nature appear in their pristine and healing majesty.

programme.title: Wenderholm & Scandretts Park: New Zealand
programme.desc: The scenery of these scenic regional parks is no less than breathtaking, with their coastal forests and rocky bluffs that border spectacular ocean views.

programme.title: Flow of Life
programme.desc: Flow of life is a relaxing film full of beautiful images of amazing landscapes. Mountains, Forests, Creeks and Rivers as well as Butterflies, Bees, Bumblebees, lizards and more. Also included are gentle breath reminders to assist in a meditative experience. All scored with relaxing music, composed by Chris Collins.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation II 1
programme.desc: Immerse your senses on an unparalleled underwater journey to some of the world's most vibrant coral reefs and undersea paradises as seen in true 4K Ultra High Definition, paired to soothing new music by Relax Moods. Viewers will discover a plethora of stunning sea creatures, thanks to the incredible underwater cinematography by Peter Schneider filmed over the last several years.

programme.title: Glacial Beauty: Newfoundland
programme.desc: Head to Newfoundland’s Amherst Cove to admire the quiet and glacial beauty of icebergs drifting across the bay.

programme.desc: Von einer magischen Shikara-Fahrt auf dem Dal-See bis hin zu einem aufwändigen Kaschmir-Wazwan erlebt Alex in Srinagar das "Paradies auf Erden“.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Alex Outhwaite besucht die berühmte Stadt Taschkent und lernt aus erster Hand die Kultur, das Essen und die Menschen kennen.

programme.title: Burn Appetit
programme.desc: Koch Jolly, ein indischer Küchenchef, der im Vereinigten Königreich lebt, möchte seine Liebe für gutes Essen und seine Leidenschaft für Motorräder auf einem epischen Trip durch Österreich verbinden.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi erkundet die prächtigen Denkmäler und architektonisch beeindruckenden Sehenswürdigkeiten von Helsinki.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.desc: Daniel Coll und Paddy Doherty besuchen ein einzigartiges Baseballspiel in einem eher unkonventionellen Stadion in Kyushus größter Stadt Fukuoka.

programme.desc: Auf der Fahrt entlang des malerischen Manali-Leh Highway hält Alex im Dorf Korzok und zeltet, wo sie die einfachen Lebensweisen erkundet.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis probiert eine Vielzahl von entgiftenden Spa-Behandlungen im Kamalaya Wellness Resort in Koh Samui, Thailand.

programme.desc: Eine berauschende Mischung aus idyllischen Stränden, wilden Abenteuern und einem pulsierenden Nachtleben, die Insel Boracay auf den Philippinen macht Elisha Kriis süchtig danach.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.desc: Daniel Coll und Paddy Doherty genießen Wanderungen zu Wasserfällen, Angeln und einen ruhigen Sonnenuntergang am Strand in Itoshima.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.sub-title: Rucksackreisen Mt. Bromo & Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Hannah Jackson besucht den jüngsten Vulkan der alten Tengger-Caldera, den Mount Bromo. Sie besucht auch die Komodowarane.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.desc: Erkunden Sie die antiken Sttten von Abu Simbel, den Philae-Tempelkomplex von Nubien und den Hatschepsut-Tempel, um die dahinter stehenden Geschichten zu entrtseln.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.desc: Vom göttlichen Thikse-Kloster bis zum ruhigen Pangong-See taucht Alex Outhwaite in Leh in das Zen ein.

programme.title: Xp Guide
programme.desc: Elisha erhascht einen Blick auf Schwedens königliches Kriegsschiff, das nach 300 Jahren unter Wasser in einem mysteriös perfekten Zustand auferstanden ist.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi geht zum Polarkreis, wo sie den Weihnachtsmann in seinem Büro trifft. Sie versucht es auch mit Mitternachtssonnenschweben.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.desc: Daniel Coll & Paddy Doherty entdecken verschiedene Möglichkeiten, Gyokuro-Tee, einen der hochwertigsten in Japan erhältlichen Tees, zu genießen, und besuchen seine Quelle.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Hannah Jackson erkundet die Landschaft, Kultur und Aromen auf den Inseln des Komodo-Nationalparks. Sie besucht auch den Tempel Taman Ayun auf Bali.

programme.title: Xplore Cambodia
programme.desc: Als Sukhmani die Tempel von Angkor besucht, stellt sie überrascht fest, dass diese nicht nur Schreine, sondern auch Statussymbole waren.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: In Der Wildnis Nubra Valley, Indien
programme.desc: Im Nubra Valley nimmt Alex am lokalen Tanz teil und macht sich dann auf den Weg zu einem Ritt auf einem baktrischen Kamel über die Hunder-Sanddünen.

programme.title: Unwind
programme.sub-title: Le Moment Détente Park Hyatt, Maldives (Fr)
programme.desc: Un luxe inégalé, de superbes plages de sable blanc et un monde sous-marin incroyable font des Maldives l'escapade tropicale parfaite. Passionnée de voyages, Indeya Passfield cherche une expérience plus locale à Hadahaa, où elle fait une excursion dans le monde aquatique avec un biologiste marin. Elle s'essaye également à la confection de préparations de fruits de mer locaux et à la pêche en bateau traditionnel.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: Gastronomie, Savoir Et Divertissement New Taipei City, Taiwan
programme.desc: À ne pas confondre avec la capitale Taipei, la nouvelle ville de Taipei est une immense étendue de terre qui entoure la capitale, englobant la majeure partie de la pointe nord de Taïwan. Alex Drobin découvre l'amour de la ville pour le baseball et la fondue, lorsqu'il teste ses compétences dans les cages des frappeurs, et savoure chaque minute pour découvrir tout ce qui se passe dans une fondue traditionnelle.

programme.title: Bliss
programme.desc: Qu'il s'agisse d'apprendre à cuisiner des spécialités traditionnelles et d'assister à une représentation du drame dansé le plus connu du Kerala, Kathakali, en passant par un traitement de spa inhabituel, développé à l'origine pour les combattants de Kalaripayattu, ses expériences lui offrent l'équilibre parfait entre culture et luxe.

programme.title: Best From The Rest
programme.sub-title: Le Top Du Top Oman 5 Attractions Incontournables
programme.desc: Un contraste saisissant de déserts, de montagnes et de plages, son paysage préservé, parsemé de grands forts, de palais exquis, de dunes ondulantes, de canyons et d'oueds luxuriants.

programme.sub-title: Goat Surf Club in Senegal ep.03
programme.desc: The Goat Surf Club visits the vibrant town of St. Louis for a taste of Senegalese culture – food, dance, and music! They'll also shred some sand dunes on a desert sandboard before hitting the waves with a local surf coach.

programme.title: Goat Surf Club
programme.sub-title: Goat Surf Club in Senegal ep.04
programme.desc: The Goat Surf Club's Senegalese finale hits a bumpy wave! Planned eco-heroes spotlights get sidelined by protests, but the crew scores big time with a kind Senegalese family who keeps them safe.

programme.title: Follow the Wind
programme.desc: Jerrie van de Kop follows the wind as he kiteboards from warm waters to snowy peaks.

programme.title: Across the Ice
programme.desc: After 45+ expeditions throughout over 150+ countries, one of the world's leading adventurers and visionaries of conservation, Swedish explorer Johan Ernst Nilson dawns upon his biggest adventure yet. Follow his journey across the planet from the North Pole to the South Pole in Pole2Pole. The 525 day mostly carbon-neutral trek covers 20,000 miles by means of skis, dogsled, boat, bike and kite. Pole2Pole is not only one of the most difficult adventures hes ever attempted, but also one of his most philanthropic adventures. Johan visits charities along the way to share their stories and raise global awareness.

programme.title: The Wake
programme.desc: A Scottish fisherman struggles to keep his craft alive in the face of ecological destruction from industrial-scale trawling.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: In the rugged mountains of western Montana, a team of researchers makes a chilling discovery: the golden eagles they study are dying from a mysterious illness.

programme.title: Seb's Surf Therapy
programme.desc: Seb is a charismatic 12-year-old with ADHD and autism who embarks on a six-week surf therapy course.

programme.title: Chasing Bliss
programme.desc: Water is life, and the great conductor that connects us all. The oceans cover over 70% of our planet and hold almost 97% of the earth's water. True bliss in constant movement giving life around the globe. This is a story of an eclectic mix of people across Hawaii, Ecuador and the USA, who draw energy from this life force and channel it positively into their everyday lives. Join Paulino in understanding what drives Surfer Laid Hamilton, or filmmaker Robert Greaves, Big-Wave World Champion Paige Alms and Windsurfing World Record Holder Sarah Hauser. Coffee Farmer Anti Clancy, Dr Greg Mitchell, Research Scientist & Algae Visionary at Scripps.

programme.title: I Am Capable
programme.desc: After experiencing injustice when hiking in the English countryside, Amira Patel decided she wanted to help create a safe space for Muslim women outdoors.

programme.title: The Last Vaquita
programme.desc: Caught up in a tale of greed and corruption, two brothers who collaborate as wildlife artists try to bring the Vaquita Porpoise back from the brink of extinction.

programme.title: JOY
programme.desc: How would you feel if you had to combine the maternity of your two children with the protection of some of the last mountain gorillas still living in freedom on our planet?

programme.title: Live to Sea
programme.desc: A saga that follows Freddie Meadows on his tireless quest along the rugged edges of Sweden, in search of the region’s greatest waves; one of the final frontiers within surfing.

programme.title: Return of the Rhino
programme.desc: In 2021, after a thirty year absence, black rhino were reintroduced to the wilds of Gonarezhou National Park in Zimbabwe. This is a story about hope, truth and the claiming of a much needed foothold for the critically endangered black rhino species.

programme.title: SLAY
programme.desc: Follow investigative filmmaker Rebecca Cappelli as she travels around the world to uncover the dark side of the fashion industry.

programme.title: A Space in Time
programme.desc: Witness the extraordinary spirit of a family who choose to see their sons' challenges as superpowers, and celebrate the beauty of life, redefined.

programme.title: MILKED
programme.desc: This gripping investigation unmasks how the million-dollar cash-cow industry has been milked dry.

programme.title: Amber Tamm
programme.desc: Amber Tamm is a young woman from Brooklyn who is a horticulturist, floral designer, community advocate, and farmer.

programme.title: Dance for Change
programme.desc: An inspiring celebration of the Dance Crews of Dzaleka Refugee camp, who are transforming their community through creative expression.

programme.title: Lowest to Highest: One Foot in Front of the Other
programme.desc: A story of overcoming personal hurdles, resilience, connection, and how adversity can strengthen communities and individuals.

programme.title: Connected Off the Grid
programme.desc: Connected Off the Grid follows the stories of three unique off-grid lifestyles from the ocean, the desert, and the redwood forest to inspire us to stay connected to the earth and their communities.

programme.title: Against the Grain
programme.desc: The story of one of the most extensive permaculture experiments in the UK.

programme.title: Consciousness of Culture
programme.desc: Bruce Parry highlights the moments of his life that formed his career and life passion to champion indigenous cultures around the world through exploration and film. Bruce is interested in altered states of mind, and the creation of myths, why do we think what we think? And what life phenomena and environments sculpt these ideas?

programme.title: The Nature of All Things
programme.desc: What is it that makes things what they are? Where does it come from? For Professor Seyyed Hossein Nasr, the quest for knowledge, specifically knowledge which enables man to understand the true nature of things and which furthermore, liberates and delivers him from the fetters and limitations of earthly existence, has been (and continues to be) the central concern and determinant of how we understand and live our lives.

programme.title: Connections Between Science & Philosophy
programme.desc: Dr. Menas Kafatos is internationally known for bridging the disciplines, writing and lecturing extensively on the convergence between science and philosophy, as there is an inherent need for a dialogue between science, spirituality, and religion. His book, Creating Cosmos with Deepak Chopra discusses the melding of topics like inflation, environmental issues, natural hazards, quantum theory and consciousness.

programme.title: Iranian Space Pioneer
programme.desc: Iranian electrical engineer, entrepreneur and former astronaut, Anousheh Ansari was the first female private space explorer to fly to the International Space Station. She explains the challenging journey and the determination needed to reach space after immigrating to the U.S. from Iran. She also became the first person to publish a blog from space. The content invited readers to share her experience with the world. She described the Russian Soyuz capsule during liftoff, talked about the sights and smells of the space station, and explained the intricacies of everyday activities.

programme.title: Philosopher of the Mind
programme.desc: Dr. Paavo Pylkknens eclectic approach combines new physics-based insights with those of analytical philosophy, phenomenology, cognitive science and neuroscience. He proposes a view in which the mechanistic framework of classical physics and neuroscience is complemented by a more holistic approach. Pylkknen is particularly known for his work on mind-body-studies, building on David Bohm's interpretation of quantum mechanics.

programme.title: Evolution of Ideas
programme.desc: Everything we can know about our lives and the universe is a subjective experience, either formed by one's own perceptions or the reports of others. Dr. Bernardo Kastrup explains how we commonly associate this understanding about the universe as something separate of our consciousness, however he strongly believes otherwise; Kastrup believes the evolution of ideas we perceive about the universe are actually originating within us.

programme.title: Book Of Knowledge
programme.desc: Traveling the world 30+ years, David Verdesi finds himself back in Rome. Urged to uncover the reason behind the instinctive human desire for spiritual yearning, Verdesi starts retracing the intersection of science and theology within the city his family has called home since the early 1400s. Vibrating from the walls of the citys sacred spaces, he discovers findings of oral history, predating the beginning of humanity by thousands of years. Documents and rare rituals that upend conventional ideas of the behaviors of the mind in ancient times. Narratives heavily influenced by civilizations and cultures beyond Rome, continue to influence the moral compass of life today, Verdesi realizes he is back on the road. Book of Knowledge The Quest for Meaning rediscovers and preserves the knowledge of our human potential and natures wisdom. This movie addresses questions around the intersection of science, spirituality, and anthropology. Join David Verdesi to the roots of the Book of Knowledge.

programme.title: Particle Physics
programme.desc: At only 21, Frank Wilczek, a graduate student at Princeton University, defined the properties of color gluons, which hold atomic nuclei together while working with David Gross. He is known, among other things, for the discovery of asymptotic freedom, the development of quantum chromodynamics, the invention of axions, and the discovery and exploitation of new forms of quantum statistics (anyons).

programme.title: Consciousness of Culture
programme.desc: Bruce Parry highlights the moments of his life that formed his career and life passion to champion indigenous cultures around the world through exploration and film. Bruce is interested in altered states of mind, and the creation of myths, why do we think what we think? And what life phenomena and environments sculpt these ideas?

programme.title: The Nature of All Things
programme.desc: What is it that makes things what they are? Where does it come from? For Professor Seyyed Hossein Nasr, the quest for knowledge, specifically knowledge which enables man to understand the true nature of things and which furthermore, liberates and delivers him from the fetters and limitations of earthly existence, has been (and continues to be) the central concern and determinant of how we understand and live our lives.

programme.title: Astrology Zone
programme.desc: Susan Miller is the founder and astrologist for AstrologyZone.com. The trusted, twenty-year-old platform provides the latest in intelligent astrological trends. This discussion with Deepak Chopra breaks down many popular misconceptions about astrological predictions, the various disciplines of study, ego, and consciousness in relation to astrology. Miller also outlines the golden rule to understanding and getting the most out of astrological predications: astrology shows the condition, but not the outcomethat outcome is completely up to you. I can give you questions to ask to help you decide, but in the end, you write the script of your life.

programme.title: Modern Metaphysical Idealism
programme.desc: Dr. Bernardo Kastrup, philosopher and author has been leading the modern renaissance of metaphysical idealism. His theoretical reflections on the mind explain consciousness as the only element of life that allows us to understand reality, and everything we know about reality is subject to our experiences. This idea is often refuted by the thought that the brain is the source, not images and experiences provided by consciousness.

programme.title: Nature, Space and Matter
programme.desc: Our understanding of the nature of time, space and matter have changedeven what we mean by these termsin just the last few decades. Our interpretations continue to change and more theories form as we learn and study these topics. Dr. Fred Alan Wolf explains the origins of many of these foundational theories that have formed at different times and why they came about. Before quantum physics, people knew that human beings were conscious. We knew that animals were conscious. But now, with new revelations in quantum physics we begin to see a new role for consciousness.

programme.title: Creation Is Constant
programme.desc: Duane Elgin wants to show that the universe is a living field of existence, and that we are always in communion with a field of aliveness whether we are conscious of it or not. Throughout this lecture, Elgin explains his belief that in a living system, each part is integral to the whole, so each entity is intimately connected to the entire universe. To him, creation is not something that happened with the Big Bang. Instead, creation is consistently forming around us from a deeper abyss. The universes existence is brought moment by moment through this continuous, moving process.

programme.title: Consciousness & Healing
programme.desc: Dr. Shamini Jain conducts clinical research in the areas of psychoneuroimmunology and integrative medicine, receiving several awards from scientific organizations for her work. Shes been continuously interested in the process of healing and strived to uncover many of the doubts she had in undergraduate school when she discovered the field psychoneuroimmunology; the integrated relationship between mind, brain and body.

programme.title: Borderline Consciousness
programme.desc: Berit Brogaard was the first researcher to show that consciousness comes in degrees and that there can be borderline cases of consciousness. Her areas of research include perception, consciousness, emotions, philosophical psychology, semantics and philosophical logic. She also researches synesthesia, savant syndrome, blind sight, and perceptual reports.

programme.title: The Knobe Effect
programme.desc: We have experiences, creativity, understanding, thoughts, feelings and desires but do we know how these occurrences happen? Joshua Knobes research has been concerned with the impact of people's moral judgments on their intuitions about this question. He believes strongly that people's intuitions about whether a particular entity is conscious, essentially depends on whether the entity has the right sort of body. Therefore, he believes embodiment shapes our view of what is reality.

programme.title: Quantifying Beauty
programme.desc: How do we scientifically quantify beauty in people and in nature? How does the world embody beautiful ideas? Dr. Frank Wilczeks conversation with Deepak Chopra discusses his book, A Beautiful Question which tests the common misconceptions about how we form our opinions on success, beauty and our imaginations.

programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: The autumn of 2006 brings hurricanes to the North Atlantic and hot dry winds fan forest fires across Northern Ontario. Host/adventurer George Kourounis has traveled to some awesome hurricanes, including Rita and Katrina, with his pal Mark Robinson. programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava ...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The curtain is about to fall for the last time. The final battle between Yuya and Reiji rages on. Dragons face off against D/D/D as the whole world watches. What will be the final fate of Yuya, Yuzu, and all four dueling dimensions?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Noah's Shinato's Ark puts Kaiba in a difficult position, as he scrambles to find a winning strategy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba regains control of the duel, but Noah brings a brainwashed Mokuba out to hinder his plans. After finally breaking through to Mokuba, Kaiba tries to embrace his brother before Noah, jealous over their close relationship, turns them to stone.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Enraged at Noah's cruel games, Yugi takes over for Kaiba and duels Noah with only 400 life points.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi's efforts to win the duel are further complicated by Noah, who turns all of his friends into stone statues, leaving Yugi feeling alone and without hope.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Gozaboro Kaiba reveals himself and plans to virtualize the entire world to create a digital kingdom. With Noah's unlikely aid, Yugi and the others must escape while fending off memories from the past.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Using Mokuba's body, Noah escapes and sets the virtual world to self-destruct. But Mokuba's kindness breaks through his heart, and he tries to set the others free. Meanwhile, Kaiba duels Gozaboro, who summons a seemingly unstoppable monster—Exodia Necross.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ami Marik destroys the computers in the control room, disabling the controls for the self-destruct mechanism, which turns the situation desperate. Meanwhile, Kaiba defeats Gozoboro Kaiba, and he and Yugi rush to the exit before the virtual world explodes. Noah erases Gozoboro's files and releases his mind, and finally makes peace with his family, and prepares for the destruction of the virtual world.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and the others arrive at KaibaCorp Island and The Battle City Finals resume. To decide who will duel whom, the four duelists--Yugi, Joey, Kaiba, and Marik-- face each other in a four-way duel in the Duel Tower.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The four-way duel continues with Joey determined to duel Marik in order to save Mai while Marik and Kaiba both intend to face Yugi. Meanwhile, Ishizu reflects on her past.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With the conclusion of the four-way duel, the match-ups for the semi-finals are determined — Joey will duel Marik while Yugi will be facing off against Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik brings Joey and himself to the Shadow Realm, where each duelist's heart is linked with his monsters, suffering the pain that the monsters feel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik's duel tactics eat away at Joey's deck and his life points. Joey's comeback strategy, however is hindered by Marik's new monster on Joey's side of the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With life points dropping and his monsters unable to attack, Joey summons a monster that proves to be his saving grace, prompting Marik to unleash Ra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite surviving Marik's onslaught, Joey is weakened by the shadow game's effects and succumbs just as he is about to win the duel. Yugi struggles to find hope after losing his best friend to the Shadow Realm.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The second duel of the semi-finals begins with Yugi dueling Kaiba for the second spot in the grand final and the chance to duel Marik. Kaiba draws Obelisk on his first turn, but Yugi thwarts his attempts to summon it with Lightforce Sword.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba and Yugi compete to summon their monsters to the field, but each is hindered by the other's strategies.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba is able to summon Obelisk the Tormentor, to the field, putting it at odds with Yugi's own Slifer the Sky Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With the destruction of both their monsters, Kaiba and Yugi are presented with a vision of the High Priest's legendary battle against the Pharaoh. Kaiba believes this to be a mere illusion, but Yugi knows that it is a vision of the past. The duel continues with Kaiba and Yugi attacking with their signature cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba gains a lead in the duel when he summons three Blue Eyes White Dragons. Yugi's hopes of winning come to an end, but receives some encouragement from Joey and stays strong in the game. Meanwhile, Joey's dreams and the ongoing duel cause Joey to awake.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba's final move forces the duelists to use only three cards, forcing to use the best cards in the decks to win the duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Tired of Kaiba's constant ridicule, Joey challenges Kaiba for third place in the Battle City tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey manages to gain one of Kaiba's strongest cards to help him advance in the duel. Meanwhile, Téa – possessed by the good half of Marik's soul – fights Yami Marik for control of the Millennium Rod.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After defeating Joey and taking third place in the tournament, Kaiba plans to destroy the Duel Tower and bury his past forever. Ishizu and Mokuba convince him otherwise, and he gives Yugi one all-powerful card that could give him a chance to defeat Marik in the final duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The final duel of Battle City begins. Yami Marik quickly turns it into a shadow game and sets it up so that if he or the Pharaoh loses, their host's soul will be destroyed. Yugi convinces the Pharaoh not to worry about him and to keep dueling to save Mai, Bakura and the good Marik. Yami Marik quickly discards his Winged Dragon of Ra to the graveyard, planning to revive it. Yugi manages to summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using his three Knights.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik uses Ra's effect to destroy Slifer and revives it once again to attack Yugi. Yugi plays the card Kaiba gave him, Fiend's Sanctuary, to stop Marik's attack. He then uses Multiply in order to summon Obelisk the Tormentor and devastate Marik.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik's good half possesses Tea again and begs Yugi to destroy him along with his evil side,but he eventually weakens and begins fading away as his dark half loses life points. Yugi and the Pharaoh become hesitant to duel, not wanting to harm the good Marik. As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi continues fending off Marik's attacks, holding out until he has the cards he needs to defeat Marik. Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul. Then, Odion arrives (although he is still weak), and tells Yami Marik that he has come to release his master (the good Marik), although Yami Marik counters this by saying that Marik's good half is almost completely gone, and that he is here to stay.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion tries to get the good Marik to resist his evil half. As a result, Yami Marik becomes angered, and attacks Odion with the Millennium Rod, which weakens Odion even more. Odion doesn't give up, despite Ishizu's protests. As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control over Marik's body, and refuses to be defeated. However, Marik's good half stalls Yami Marik long enough for Yugi to activate his spell card. Yugi's Ragnarok spell succeeds in destroying (and removing to the graveyard) Ra, allowing the good Marik to regain control of his body. However, a sliver of Yami Marik reappears on the field, although this time, he is the victim. Yami Marik tries to convince the good Marik to help him seize the Millennium Items and rule the world together, but fails as Marik has decided to stop being evil and make up for his actions. Marik surrenders the duel to Yugi, which sends Yami Marik to the Shadow Realm, ending the Battle City finals. Bakura and Mai are returned from the shadow realm and Marik is reunited with his siblings, who forgive him. Yugi receives the three Egyptian God Cards. Kaiba then activates the Duel Tower's self-destruct sequence, giving everybody one hour to get off the island before it explodes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and the gang escape from the island in time, but they are forced to leave Kaiba and Mokuba behind. The brothers get away just as the island explodes using the Blue-Eyes White Jet. Yugi's group heads back to Domino City, where they say their farewells and go their separate ways.

programme.desc: Téa shows Serenity around the city, to all the sites of the important duels of the Battle City Tournament, while Joey duels Yugi to get his Red-Eyes Black Dragon back. Téa eventually meets up with Yugi, and they head off for further adventures.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 4: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: ¡Yugi combina sus monstruos magnéticos en la potencia polar de Valkyrion el Guerrero Magno! Sin embargo, poco sabe Yugi que Umbra y Lumis tienen una última máscara para volver a los monstruos de Yugi contra él.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Kaiba van en misión de rescate para salvar a sus amigos. Pero en el camino, todas sus preocupaciones y secretos se revelan al revivir los problemas que han enfrentado... ¡y que enfrentarán en el futuro!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelo es de amigo contra amigo porque Marik controla mentalmente a Joey para que se bata en duelo contra Yugi. El perdedor será arrastrado al océano. ¿Podrá Yugi liberar a Joey de su hechizo, o será Joey el que acabe con Yugi?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Aunque Joey le ha diezmado sus puntos de vida, Yugi no se atreve a atacar a su querido amigo. Yugi convoca al monstruo favorito de Joey, el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, para intentar que Joey recupere la cordura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi empieza a romper el hechizo de Marik sobre Joey, pero ahora debe batirse en duelo sin el Rompecabezas del Milenio. Cuando Joey roba la carta que necesita para diezmar los puntos de vida de Yugi, ¿qué posibilidades le quedan para ganar?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Solo queda un minuto de duelo para que el perdedor caiga en las profundidades del mar. ¿Se enviarán estos mejores amigos a su perdición? Sin embargo, puede haber una salvadora especial que acaba de recuperar la vista.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es la batalla de los espectros porque Bakura desata su ejército de fantasmas contra los feroces zombis de Bonz para poder entrar en la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla. Pero, ¿por quién doblará la campana final cuando jueguen en el Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un juego de amor porque el rompecorazones de Hollywood, Jean-Claude Magnum, desafía a Mai a un duelo para conseguir su mano. ¿Sucumbirá Mai al encanto de Jean-Claude, por no hablar de su grupo de monstruos ninja?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Que comience la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla! Los ocho finalistas pondrán a prueba su habilidad y resistencia en una arena de duelo a miles de metros de altura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 1
programme.desc: Es el primer duelo de la final. Yugi se enfrenta al espíritu maligno del Anillo del Milenio que posee a Bakura. Yugi se deshace de los grotescos espectros de Bakura, pero él tiene una estrategia sacada directamente del cementerio…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 2
programme.desc: Bakura activa el Tablero del Destino, que hará que Yugi pierda automáticamente en cinco turnos. Por si fuera poco, el Santuario Oscuro de Bakura daña los puntos de vida de Yugi cada vez que ataca! Sin poder atacar y sin tiempo, Yugi está atrapado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 3
programme.desc: Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi está a punto de dar el golpe final para ganar el duelo, pero Bakura podría no sobrevivir a la explosión del todopoderoso monstruo egipcio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La furia de los dioses egipcios
programme.desc: ¡Por fin se revela el origen de las cartas de dioses egipcios! El misterioso Shadi lleva a Yugi a un viaje a través del tiempo hasta la creación de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡y los peligrosos poderes que liberó!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: En el segundo duelo de la final, Odion, disfrazado de Marik, desconcierta a Joey con numerosas trampas para llevar el duelo a un punto muerto. Sin embargo, Joey cuenta con la Tornado Gigante, la contrapartida perfecta que garantiza la victoria de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Las Encarnaciones de Apophis de Odion se ensañan con los monstruos de Joey... ¡y con sus puntos de vida! ¿Podrá Joey utilizar eficazmente los monstruos que ganó antes en el torneo, o está ya demasiado nervioso para montar un contraataque exitoso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un frenesí devorador porque el Serket de Odion devora a los monstruos de Joey para transformarse en poderosas etapas de evolución. ¿Cómo puede Joey derrotar a Serket cuando éste ingiere los monstruos de Joey cada vez que los invoca en el campo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion utiliza una carta de dios egipcio falsa para invocar al tercer monstruo divino egipcio, el Dragón Alado de Ra, y lo utiliza para aniquilar los cinco puntos de vida que le quedan a Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 1
programme.desc: El tercer duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla entre Mai y Marik no es un duelo normal. Es una batalla en el temido Reino de las Sombras donde perder puntos de vida equivale a perder tus recuerdos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 2
programme.desc: A medida que Mai pierde cada vez más recuerdos bajo el implacable asalto de Marik, también pierde la confianza en sus habilidades para combatir en duelos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 3
programme.desc: Mai se hace con el control del Dragón Alado de Ra de Marik, pero es incapaz de averiguar cómo desatar sus poderosas habilidades.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un duelo con el destino: Kaiba contra Ishizu: Parte 1
programme.desc: En el cuarto duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla, la misteriosa oponente de Kaiba es... ¡Ishizu! Con el poder de su Collar del Milenio, Ishizu puede ver el futuro. ¡Incluso todas las cartas que Kaiba tiene previsto jugar!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un duelo con el destino: Kaiba contra Ishizu: Parte 2
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia de su Collar del Milenio, Ishizu ya ha visto el resultado del duelo: ¡derrotará a Kaiba con su trampa! ¿Cómo puede ganar Kaiba si ya está destinado a perder? Es hora de que Kaiba cambie el futuro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El secreto de los guardianes de tumbas
programme.desc: A medida que crece la maldad de Marik, Ishizu revela los secretos de su linaje: ¿Cómo pasó Marik de niño bondadoso a tirano ávido de poder que quiere dominar el mundo? ¿Podrá Yugi salvar a Marik del borde de las tinieblas, o ya es demasiado tarde?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El enfrentamiento en las sombras: Marik contra Bakura: Parte 1
programme.desc: Con su pacto anterior roto, Bakura se bate en duelo con Marik para conseguir el derecho a controlar la Vara del Milenio y el Anillo del Milenio. ¡El perdedor quedará atrapado en el Reino de las Sombras para siempre!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El enfrentamiento en las sombras: Marik contra Bakura: Parte 2
programme.desc: Bakura y el Marik bueno invocan al Dragón Alado de Ra, listo para explotar y desterrar al Marik malo al Reino de las Sombras. Pero el Dragón Alado de Ra tiene más de una habilidad especial. ¡Y el malvado Marik sabe utilizarlas todas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El dirigible de Kaiba se dirige a la isla de KaibaCorp para las rondas finales del Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla. Un niño llamado Noah y sus secuaces secuestran su nave: ¡Cinco enemigos conocidos del pasado de Yugi y Kaiba que buscan venganza!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Noah despliega el poder de su mundo virtual dividiendo a la banda de Yugi y arrojándola a los confines de su universo autocreado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi intentar entender el sistema del Maestro de la Baraja. Big 1 utiliza su habilidad de Maestro de la Baraja para devolverle a Yugi todos sus ataques. ¿Cómo puede Yugi derrotar a un oponente cuando sus ataques le quitan sus propios puntos de vida?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se está quedando sin puntos de vida, pero ¿podrá su pequeño y adorable Maestro de la Baraja Kuriboh desatar su furia peluda para cambiar el rumbo de la batalla?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Prepárate para una lucha de plumas cuando Téa se enfrente al Pingüino de Pesadilla de Big 2 Crump, donde el perdedor quedará atrapado para siempre en un bloque de hielo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El cuerpo de Téa se está convirtiendo en un polo gigante. ¿Podrá evitar que su cerebro se congele para encontrar la manera de derretir la estrategia de Big 2?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey se enfrenta al juez tarado Big 3 Johnson, que adopta la forma de Maestro de la Baraja del impresionante mediador Juez Man.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Justo cuando Joey parece llevar la delantera, se encuentra con la racha de mala suerte más larga de la historia de la humanidad.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Big 4 Nezbitt desafía a Duke, Tristán y Serenity para obtener el derecho a controlar los tres cuerpos a la vez.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Uno menos, quedan dos. Con la pérdida de Tristán, Serenity tiene el corazón roto. ¿Podrá recomponerse y recordar las lecciones que le enseñó Tristán para dar la vuelta al duelo? Puede que Tristán se haya ido, pero ha dejado un regalo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El Cañón Satélite de Big 5 ataca a los monstruos de Kaiba desde el espacio profundo, donde ninguno de los monstruos de Kaiba puede alcanzarlo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba llega al refugio de Noah para rescatar a Mokuba, pero Mokuba quiere quedarse con Noah.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Fusión de los cinco grandes: Parte 1
programme.desc: Noah les da a los Cinco Grandes una última oportunidad de redimirse en un duelo por equipos de cinco contra dos en el que Yugi y Joey se enfrentan a los Cinco Grandes al completo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Fusión de los cinco grandes: Parte 2
programme.desc: Los Cinco Grandes concentran su ataque en Joey con la esperanza de derrotarlo para que Yugi se vea obligado a batirse en duelo solo contra toda su formidable fuerza.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Fusión de los cinco grandes: Parte 3
programme.desc: Los Cinco Grandes convocan a un dragón todopoderoso que ya derrotó a Joey, Mai y Mokuba en un mundo virtual alternativo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Noah se enfrenta a Kaiba en un duelo para obtener el control de KaibaCorp.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El Arca de Shinato de Noé roba monstruos en su fortaleza para usarlos como un muro impenetrable de sirvientes!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está a punto de acabar con Noah, ¡pero Mokuba protege a Noah de su golpe final!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La amenaza final de Noah: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi, harto de la traición de Noah, toma el lugar de Kaiba en el duelo. Sin embargo, en cada turno que pasa, uno de los amigos de Yugi se transforma en piedra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La amenaza final de Noah: Parte 2
programme.desc: Uno a uno, todos los amigos de Yugi se van convirtiendo en sólidas estatuas de piedra. Pero aunque la pandilla esté congelada, ¡sus espíritus siguen vivos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha derrotado a Noah, pero siguen sin poder escapar del mundo virtual. Se revela la verdadera razón detrás de su trampa... ¡así como el verdadero villano que mueve los hilos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un misil destruirá la base submarina en treinta minutos, pero nuestros héroes siguen atrapados dentro y no pueden escapar.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba se enfrenta a Gozaburo -y a sus propios demonios- para intentar conquistar por fin su doloroso pasado, pero ¿cómo podrá Kaiba derrotar a la Exodia Necross de Gozaburo, que no puede ser destruido por hechizos, trampas o ni siquiera ataques?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba se enfrenta a Gozaburo -y a sus propios demonios- para intentar conquistar por fin su doloroso pasado, pero ¿cómo podrá Kaiba derrotar a la Exodia Necross de Gozaburo, que no puede ser destruido por hechizos, trampas o ni siquiera ataques?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: De vuelta en Ciudad de la Batalle: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos llegan a la isla de KaibaCorp, donde los finalistas de la Ciudad de la Batalla competirán en la arena de duelo definitiva, la majestuosa Torre del Duelo que se extiende cientos de metros en las nubes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: De vuelta en Ciudad de la Batalle: Parte 2
programme.desc: Honor, amistad, venganza... Mientras cada uno de los duelistas recuerda por qué está luchando, la batalla real se desata y ninguno de los duelistas sabe de dónde vendrá el próximo ataque.
